sentences.text: Mangi Lal @ Mantilal vs State on 4 April, 2017
Author: Sandeep Mehta Bench: Sandeep Mehta

HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Misc(Pet.) No. 994 / 2017 Mangilal @ Mantilal S/o Sh. Ratanlal, By Caste Jain, Resident of Mandawala, Tehsil and District Jalore, Presently Residing At 5-3- 826/201, Om Shanti Apartment, Gasha Mahal, Hyderabad (Telangana)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State of Rajasthan  ----Respondent _____________________________________________________ For Petitioner : Mr. Pradeep Shah.
For Respondent-State : Mr. M.S. Panwar, PP.
_____________________________________________________  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP MEHTA Order 04/04/2017 Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner may be allowed to surrender and move an application for regular bail before the trial court which in turn be directed to consider and decide it on the same date.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner is being summoned through a warrant of arrest in relation to complaint filed against him for offence under Section 7/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954, which is bailable in nature.
In this background, the petitioner is given liberty to surrender before the learned trial Court on or before 5 th of May, 2017 and move a regular bail application.
Upon such application being submitted by the petitioner, the learned trial Court shall consider and decide the same as per law on the same date.
(2 of 2) [CRLMP-994/2017] The instant misc. petition and the stay application are disposed of in the aforesaid terms.

(SANDEEP MEHTA), J.
